method: Robust median of pre-v15 active-FX5 gain discrepancies, rounded to0.05dB. V15 is a held-out two-pass check. CW remains a known residual; no per-layer or FX6 gain fit.
scope: Active FX5 gain only; fresh-note/FX6 unchanged. Rounded pre-v15 training measurements; V15 two hardware passes held out. Source termination not fixed.
